exam_scheme.note: Tamil Nadu Common Entrance Test (TANCET) and Common Engineering Entrance Test and Admissions (CEETA-PG) are conducted annually by Anna University, Chennai on behalf of the Government of Tamil Nadu for admission into post-graduate professional degree programmes (M.B.A., M.C.A., and M.E./M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan.). All tests are administered as 2-hour offline pen-and-paper OMR examinations with negative marking of 1/4 mark per wrong answer.

stages.stage_name: Entrance Test (Single Paper, Offline OMR Method)
stages.source_label: Anna University TANCET/CEETA-PG 2026 Information to Candidates, Section 8: Guidelines and Syllabi for the Entrance Test

papers.paper_name: TANCET — M.B.A. Paper (Data Analysis, Reading Comprehension, Quantitative Aptitude, Data Sufficiency, English Usage)
TANCET — M.C.A. Paper (Quantitative Ability, Analytical Ability, Logical Reasoning, Computer Awareness)
CEETA-PG — M.E. / M.Tech. / M.Arch. / M.Plan. (Part I Engg Mathematics, Part II Basic Engineering & Sciences, Part III Technical Specialization)

competition_benchmarks.note: TANCET is the single-window gateway for thousands of state quota seats across University departments, Government, Government-aided, and affiliated self-financing colleges in Tamil Nadu. Candidate numbers reflect official registration and appearance statistics certified by Anna University.
